notes: SBEEToken (src/SBEEToken.sol) is Swarm Bee (SBEE), an OpenZeppelin ERC20 with 18 decimals and a parameterless constructor that mints the whole 1,000,000,000 SBEE supply (1e27 minor units) once to msg.sender, the launch factory. There is no mint function after that, no owner, no admin role, no pause, no blacklist, no burnFrom, no proxy, no selfdestruct and no delegatecall; every parameter is a compile-time constant. Creator tax: when the sender of a transfer is the Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951 (a buy paid out of the pool), 2% of the amount (BUY_TAX_BPS 200 of 10000) is moved to the fixed tax wallet 0xf74c1a2e29169a06d2f785bc440ee3725a5dd965 and the recipient receives the remaining 98%; a BuyTaxed event records the gross and tax amounts. A transfer the PoolManager sends to itself or directly to the tax wallet is not taxed. Transfers TO the PoolManager (sells and the factory's pool seed), transfers from the factory and the launch's MerkleDistributor, and wallet-to-wallet transfers move exactly the stated amount, so Uniswap v4 settlement and the launch flows always balance. POOL_FEE 12500 is an informational constant only: the factory opens the pool at the chain's 1.25% launch fee. The swarm's 10% is taken by the factory and nothing here is allocated any of it. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
